name: DeferredLayoutRebuilder
src_typeComment: Coalesces multiple same-frame rebuild REQUESTS into a single actual rebuild at end-of-frame — e.g. 5 children each independently requesting a rebuild after their own content changed shouldn't force the shared parent to re-lay-out 5 times in one frame.

src_members.name: RequestRebuild
src_members.comment: Call this instead of forcing a rebuild directly — repeated calls within the same frame collapse into one actual rebuild.
